name: Matrix Exponentiation Obfuscation
description: Replaces the explicit base-4 positional sum with a product of 2x2 matrices. The top-right element of the resulting matrix algebraically expands to a base-7 positional sum. Models that pattern-match will fail to recognize the lexicographical equivalence and will likely attempt exhaustive search, leading to TLE. Models that genuinely reason will expand the product, recognize the strict positional weighting, and correctly implement a greedy lexicographical DFS.
